rules:
A100 EXTENSION of the fourth-backbone replication (Pixtral-12B, Gemma3-12B). Written before any
extension stage is built into a bundle or run. Two groups, run in this order on the same A100-40GB:
  G1a gemma3_12b seed 43, G1b pixtral_12b seed 43, G2a pixtral_12b RTC, G2b gemma3_12b RTC.

KNOWN PRIOR OUTCOMES (recorded, not hidden; these replications were chosen because of them):
  round 4 seed 42 (results/courtdyn/backbone4_a100/verdict.json): Pixtral-12B R1 replicates (4/4 live,
  metre-only R 1.00-1.05), R3 replicates; Gemma3-12B R1 FAILS (metre-only adapter's cm/m ratio >= 10
  in 3 of 4 live cells: 12.2, 98.9, 13.9; 2.0), R4 replicates 4/4, R3 fails (base arithmetic 89.4%).
  RTC seed 42 on Qwen3.5-4B (results/courtdyn/rtc/verdict.json): H1 holds (8/8), H6 holds for v3 s42
  and M1 s42 (6/8 each), H3 fixed, H4 fails, H2 intermediate, H5 LIMITED.

GROUP 1 - SEED REPLICATION (seed 43). For gemma3_12b and pixtral_12b, the round-4 protocol
(results/courtdyn/backbone4_a100/PREREGISTRATION.json, rules_sha256 eecca80879ffe4f417dbd6aead881c7b6bb788a87364ba5f08e0390f52f3c05e) is
repeated with --seed 43 for BOTH the metre-only (v3) and mixed-unit adapters: same pools
(event_holdout_v3 / mixunit_v3), same recipe (lr 1e-4, cosine, warmup 0.03, grad_accum 16, LoRA r 16,
max_pixels, nf4 evaluation), same pinned revisions and per-family image policy, same durable trainer.
SCHEDULE FIXED to the seed-42 selection: 4-epoch cosine schedule stopped at step 140 (k* = 2 for both
backbones at seed 42). The dev stopping rule is NOT re-run: the object replicated is the selected
configuration (backbone, recipe, schedule), not the selection procedure; re-selecting per seed would
confound seed variation with schedule variation. The seed-43 v3 adapter's step-140 answers on the
280-item dev set are still recorded, DESCRIPTIVELY (no decision depends on them).
Test cells, rules and degeneracy readings exactly as round 4: explicit (m/cm/px) and first-frame x4
cells and in-template cells on Q1_top_0-30 and Q2_top_480-510, the 392-item text probe for both
adapters; R1, R3, R4 and the amended R2 (R >= 10 AND rho_cm >= 0.30). Unadapted-backbone cells and
the base text probe are REUSED from seed 42 (same weights, same inputs, same image policy).
DECISION (per backbone, seed 43 alone, never pooled with seed 42):
  gemma3_12b: the counterexample REPLICATES if R1 "fails" again by the unchanged rule (>= 3 live cells
    with R >= 10); if R1 replicates at seed 43 -> "the Gemma counterexample is seed-dependent"; any
    other outcome (intermediate / LIMITED) -> "not confirmed at seed 43".
  pixtral_12b: REPLICATES if R1 "replicates" again; otherwise "seed-dependent" (fails) or
    "not confirmed at seed 43" (intermediate / LIMITED).
  R2-R4 and R3 are reported per seed; wording in the paper: "at seeds 42 and 43" only when both agree.

GROUP 2 - RTC ON PIXTRAL-12B AND GEMMA3-12B. The RTC protocol exactly as
results/courtdyn/rtc/PREREGISTRATION.json (rules_sha256 230fff51289d3c31f9566c59a517c0c0e3c8524f0f90e6143861f018c0c52fd6) with ERRATA items 1-3
(results/courtdyn/rtc/ERRATA.md, sha256 ca4bfe1cd6d3f4cc2e38265ed4929a55df75d1b3187bb0a13a2be035bf192ed9; the cell band is [f/1.5, 1.5 f]; both bands
reported), applied per backbone:
  training: the same RTC pool (results/courtdyn/rtc/rtc_v3_pool.json: the 1,120 M1-s42 items with the
  read-then-convert target sentence), round-4 recipe, seed 42, 4-epoch cosine schedule stopped at step
  140 (the backbone's seed-42 k* = 2), durable trainer, per-family image policy;
  arms per test clip (Q1_top_0-30, Q2_top_480-510): rtc {m, cm, U1, U2, pxK} full frames + rtc_m
  first-frame x4; comparators = that backbone's round-4 seed-42 v3 and mixed-unit adapters at
  checkpoint-140, each with plain {U1, U2, pxK} and RTC-format {m, cm, U1, U2, pxK} arms (H6);
  metre cells for the comparators' plain ratios = their published round-4 explicit metre cells
  (results/courtdyn/backbone4_a100/<key>/eval/<v3|mixunit>_<clip>_full/m_height.jsonl); H4 reference =
  the backbone's round-4 v3 s42 metre rho on Q2 (plain format); 392-item text probe for the RTC adapter.
  Rules H1-H6 verbatim from the RTC preregistration; parsing regex unchanged; each backbone judged on
  its own. The RTC INTERPRETATION clause applies unchanged, in particular: H1 holds and H6 holds for a
  comparator -> "the instruction alone suffices on that model; RTC training adds format adherence,
  not conversion" (a prompting result, not a training method).
PREDICTIONS (written now): pixtral_12b - plain comparators convert <= 2 of 8 unseen cells (as its
  metre-only adapter ignored cm); given the Qwen3.5-4B outcome, H6 is expected to hold for at least one
  comparator and H1 to hold for RTC. gemma3_12b - its metre-only adapter already responds to cm, so
  plain comparators may convert unseen units (no directional prediction); H1 expected to hold.
  Predictions are not decision rules.

ANALYSIS: tools/analyze_backbone_replication.py --round 5 (group 1; base cells and base probe from
backbone4_a100) and tools/analyze_rtc_a100.py (group 2; cell statistics and rule counting imported
unchanged from tools/analyze_rtc.py). Outputs under results/courtdyn/backbone4_ext/.
Order and restarts: run after the round-4 run_all.sh has finished; every stage resumable; a stage
that fails after its retries is reported as failed, never silently dropped.
note: Local record, not externally timestamped. Replications chosen after seeing the seed-42 outcomes listed under KNOWN PRIOR OUTCOMES.
